beginner.best_for: First marathon runners with at least 8-12 weeks of consistent easy running.
entry_checks: Runs at least three days per week
Has averaged at least 20 km per week for the last four weeks
Can complete 75 minutes of easy running or run-walk without pain

intermediate.best_for: Consistent recreational runners targeting a strong finish or personal best.
entry_checks: Runs at least four days per week
Has averaged at least 30 km per week for the last six weeks
Has a recent 10 km or half-marathon result

advanced.best_for: Experienced marathoners with durable volume and a performance goal.
entry_checks: Runs at least five days per week
Has averaged at least 45 km per week for the last eight weeks
Has completed a half marathon or marathon preparation block

competitive.best_for: High-level amateur runners with multi-year volume history and coach-level review.
entry_checks: Runs five to seven days per week
Has averaged at least 65 km per week for the last eight weeks
Has recent race data and can recover from two quality sessions plus a long run

age_bands.label: adult
age_bands.coaching: Use normal progression when sleep, pain, and completion quality are stable.

age_bands.label: masters
age_bands.coaching: Protect warm-up time and avoid stacking plyometrics or hard running when tendon response is poor.

age_bands.label: masters-55-plus
age_bands.coaching: Protect two recovery touchpoints each week and prefer lower-impact substitutions when joints are irritated.
